result: In `counter8_core`, replace the `else if (enable)` increment with an unconditional enabled addition in the non-reset branch, using `count_reg + {7'b0, enable}` so a low enable adds zero and holds the value. Keep the synchronous reset branch first and preserve the registered 8-bit output; retain `// @latency 1` on `counter8`. Compare routed LUTs against the incumbent and keep the candidate only if it passes every gate and strictly improves the LUT objective.
